Activity: Consume 1 Stat Enhancing Food or Drink
Description: Cuisine defines the provinces of Tamriel, from homestyle Dark Elf Root Cake to High Elf Honey Beer. Many foods and drinks provide long-lasting buffs, so try one today!
Experience consumables increase the amount of experience earned for a certain amount of in-game time.
Activity Reward: File:ON-icon-store-Grand Gold Coast Experience Scroll.png Hero's Return Experience Scroll

Description: Banks are located in large cities throughout Tamriel. Open the map, and look for the treasure chest icon. Then just go where the money is!
Pack Merchants can be located in the marketplaces of most large cities. Open the map, and look for the scales icon. Nested beneath one is likely to be the pack merchant's bag.
Stable Masters are usually located on the outskirts of large cities throughout Tamriel. Open the map, and look for the horse icon to tend to your faithful steed.
Quests tell sweeping tales and allow for grand adventures across the continent! Look for the quest icon above a character, or review your current quests in the journal.

Activity: Fast Travel Directly From a Wayshrine
Description: By entering the map interface at a Wayshrine, you can travel for free instantly to any other player house, dungeon, trial, or wayshrine in Tamriel.
